name: remote-branch-history
goal: A history built in a fresh clone holds every source branch the clone knows, also those it has only as remote-tracking refs, with their real ancestry, under names that cannot collide with a local branch and never relabel a stale local tip

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Codex's fresh clone of the pushed history rebuilt 1 branch and 49 revisions where the implementation index has 13 and 66: the history listed local branches only, and a normal clone has every branch but one as a remote-tracking ref. Expected: every branch the clone knows is listed with its real ancestry; a local branch keeps its name and tip; a remote-only branch keeps its plain name when the remotes agree; a remote tip that differs is listed as <remote>:<branch>; evidence, notes, archives, tags and a remote HEAD are never branches.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: work/logs/stage-f-remote-branches-RED.log: the final test/history-branches.e2e.test.ts against the committed SourceHistoryRepository, 2 failed: the clone's index held only main where four branches were expected, and a stale local branch hid the remote tip.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: New unit function.source-branches (generated) holds the naming; SourceHistoryRepository reads refs with their symbolic targets and the configured remotes and lists what it names. No index field was added, so a clone rebuilds the same bytes as the repository it was pushed from. README and the history guidance state the rule.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: work/logs/stage-f-remote-branches-green-1.log and a later run: test/history-branches.e2e.test.ts 2 passed (a real clone of a bare remote: four branches, one with a slash and a hash sign, same index digest as the original; a stale local branch and a local branch named origin/topic beside origin:topic) and test/utils/source-branches.test.ts 5 passed. Eight existing history suites passed unchanged, 31 tests. Read-only Git queries on the acceptance clone now give 13 branches and 66 revisions; this checkout gives 15, the two new ones being origin:main and harness-proof-local:main, whose tip differs from the local main.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: bun run check exit 0 on the working tree (work/logs/stage-f-check-8.log): 458 unit tests with 25 live-API tests skipped, 183 command-line end-to-end tests in 56 files, 31 package tests in 12 files with 3 scale tests skipped, 121 reports unit tests in 55 files, audit and registry check passed. Whole browser suite on the final build: 120 passed, 1 skipped (work/logs/stage-f-browser-suite-three-gaps-final.log). The complete verification was not run; it is Codex's. No page changed for this loop; a path with a colon in the branch name is covered by test/utils/source-branches.test.ts. The repository's own index built with this code holds 15 branches and 66 revisions with no problems (work/stage-f/own-failures/build.json).
